│                                                                              │
│  A vault now, or the embedded wallet only for now?                           │
│                                                                              │
│  A vault keeps your recovery words and guards every owner step with a        │
│  passphrase or a security key. You can add one any time.                     │
│  Pick one of two:                                                            │
│  ▸ 1  The embedded wallet only, for now                                      │
│      · Owner steps, like making your agent's key, are approved by you in     │
│        the pane.                                                             │
│      · A wallet of its own, or a send from the Candle Harness, needs a       │
│        vault: set one up later from settings ▾.                              │
│      · Funds out go through Candle's site.                                   │
│                                                                              │
│    2  A vault now                           candle vault init, in the pane   │
│      · Your 24 recovery words, shown once. Write them down.                  │
│      · A passphrase on every owner step; a security key can be added next.   │
│        Touch ID is coming.                                                   │
│      · A wallet of its own for your agent needs Pro or Max; on Free a vault  │
│                                                                              │
